finalText:
**Do not sign this off as a flat rename.** 1291 hits sit in 94 files. Only about 980 are safe.

| Must not rename | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | applied history, needs a new migration |
| SQL strings in `src/repo/*.js` | 125 | real column name |
| `req.session.account_id` | 100 | key set outside this repo |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | overwritten by `vendor:refresh` |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | public contract, frozen field |
| `WIRE` values in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 1 | public wire name |

Next: ask them for a column migration plan first.
